contract.note: 正视墙面条带（左右两个 64 宽变体），程序斜切贴到每格的前面和右面（右面压冷色阴影），底行=地面线，向上平铺；cave 高 256 上下无缝（圆块岩石），crypt/maze 高=墙高；岩石/砖块自带深色描边，矮墩只取底部 14px

prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. Materials: rounded chunky natural cave rock; local palette: pale lavender-blue frosted stone and opaque ice, gentle cream highlights. ORTHOGRAPHIC FRONT ELEVATION wall material strip, NOT an isometric object, no top surface, no ground, no scenery. Fill the whole rectangular canvas with large rounded rocks or broad masonry blocks and soft plum mortar lines. Two equal-width vertical variants side by side, same colors, no divider. Vertical walls with calm flat lighting; directional shade supplied by engine. Bottommost 14/104 of the image must read as a low solid stone plinth. Edges tile without a border; cave rocks tile vertically too. Canvas proportion 1:2. Both halves MUST use the SAME material category. Only large simple rounded natural rock blocks. No doors, windows, arches, niches, symbols, decorations or crystal clusters. Keep stone faces broad and readable at 64 pixels per half.
